title: From Order to Distribution: An Exact Operator Framework for Forgetting in Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.13460v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A central challenge in continual learning is forgetting: the loss of performance on previously learned tasks after learning new ones. Prior theory has analyzed forgetting under random orderings of fixed task collections in overparameterized linear regression. We shift the focus from task order to task distribution, asking how its structure determines forgetting. In the linear setting with a shared solution, i.i.d. task sampling, and sequential exact fitting, we derive an exact operator identity expressing historical forgetting directly in terms of the task distribution. Building on this identity, we establish an exponential decay guarantee for expected historical forgetting under every fixed task distribution in finite dimensions, characterize its asymptotic behavior, and relate decay to the distribution's coverage of observable directions. translated_title: 从顺序到分布：持续学习中遗忘的精确算子框架
translated_abstract: 持续学习中的一个核心挑战是遗忘：即在学习新任务后，模型在先前已学任务上的性能损失。以往的理论研究主要在过参数化线性回归中，分析固定任务集合在随机排序下的遗忘现象。我们将研究焦点从任务顺序转向任务分布，探究其结构如何决定遗忘。在共享解的线性设置、独立同分布任务采样以及顺序精确拟合的条件下，我们推导出一个精确的算子恒等式，能够直接用任务分布来表达历史遗忘。基于这一恒等式，我们在有限维空间中为任意固定任务分布下的期望历史遗忘建立了指数衰减保证，刻画了其渐近行为，并将衰减速度与任务分布对可观测方向的覆盖程度联系起来。对于单个已学习的任务，我们证明了后续任务可以共同支持……（摘要内容不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个精确算子恒等式框架，将持续学习中遗忘的研究从任务顺序转向任务分布，并证明在任意固定任务分布下，期望历史遗忘均呈现指数衰减，其衰减速度取决于分布对可观测方向的覆盖程度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an exact operator identity framework that shifts the study of forgetting in continual learning from task order to task distribution, proving that expected historical forgetting decays exponentially under any fixed task distribution, with the decay rate tied to the distribution's coverage of observable directions.
